Changes in text books
*1. SHRI MANOJ BHATTACHARYA:
Will  the  Minister  of  HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the large scale changes made by the NCERT
in the various text books prescribed for the
school students;
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government’s reaction thereto; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
to correct these changes, if warranted, so
as to ensure the factual accuracy and
objectivity of such books?
India on priority watch list over IPRs
*2. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether United States has once again
put India on the priority watch list of its
301 provision of the trade laws over
inadequate protection of intellectual
property rights;
(b) whether amendments in the Indian
Patent laws which became effective from
May, 2003 have been considered inadequate
by the U.S.; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps Government propose to take to
further improve its patent laws?

DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
legalise prostitution by providing licenses
to the women engaged in this profession;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have made any
alternative arrangements to get them proper
status in the society;
(d) whether they are now being provided
with licenses after the failure of the above
arrangements; and

2000;

(d) if so, the details thereof; and

Services (ICDS) Scheme

DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:

Rupees six thousand per annum and

the recommendations of the Panel and if

(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

SIRIGIREDDY:

 SIRIGIREDDY:

SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether IIMs. have evolved any

papers

SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that papers of

 Export/Import of goods
